arguments.message:
You can trim your own notification volume right away:
1. In Meridian, open **Profile → Notifications**.
2. Each notification type (assignment, mention, status‑change, digest, etc.) has its own toggle – turn off the ones you don’t need.
3. If you only want alerts for items assigned to you, leave **Assignment** notifications on and disable the others.

These changes apply instantly and only affect your account; no admin changes are required. Let me know if you need any further help!
